decision.summary: A confirmed multi-axis temporary offset occurs 525–534, with coherent sharp excursions in N, E, and U followed by full recovery. A second candidate offset 545–555 shows correlated N/U step-down without E response and no observed return, hence uncertain. No other temporary intervals meet criteria within allowed context.

intervals.observation: N drops sharply over ~5 samples (525–530), then recovers by 534; E dips concurrently (526–530) and rebounds by 534; U spikes sharply at 527 (~18 MAD), then collapses by 534. All three axes show coherent multi-sample transient with clear onset, sustained interior (2–4 samples), and return to pre-event trend by end of interval. Confirmed temporary offset.

N and U show correlated step-down starting ~545, persisting through 555; E remains flat with no matching step. Return not observed: N/U remain offset relative to pre-545 trend beyond 555, and no opposing excursion is evident in allowed context. Uncertain whether this is a secondary temporary offset or part of ongoing trend/step. No clear return within [450,699].
